title: Nomenclature
notes: GENERAL NOTE: For Code reference to this Appendix, see para. 300.3.

NOTE: (1) Note that the use of these units is not required by the Code. They represent sets of consistent units (except where otherwise stated) that may be used in computations, if stress values in ksi and MPa are multiplied by 1,000 for use in equations that also involve pressure in psi and kPa values.
